name: @pipeworx/mcp-eu-parliament

tools.name: meps
tools.description: List the Members of the European Parliament sitting NOW, filterable by country and political group. Pass `term` to query the historical register instead.

country.description: Member state — country name ("Ireland"), ISO2 ("IE") or ISO3 ("IRL") all work.

group.description: EP political group. The nine sitting groups are PPE (EPP), S&D, PfE, ECR, Renew, Verts/ALE (Greens), The Left, NI, ESN — pass any of those spellings, or the English name; casing and &/ separators are normalized for you.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-eu-parliament forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the eu-parliament pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
